    dist.broadcast(inp.detach(), src=0); dist.broadcast(w.detach(), src=0)
    inp.grad=None; w.grad=None
    out=tensor_parallel_matmul(inp,w,world_size,rank)
    ref=inp.detach()@w.detach()
    maxerr=(out.detach()-ref).abs().max().item()

    dist.all_gather(lst, out.detach())
